title: Inner Land Minesweeper
summary: Arm mines, chain their blasts, and hook a charged cluster into the shielded boss. Clear the field, then beat your own time.
about: Arm mines, chain their blasts, and hook a charged cluster into the shielded boss. Clear the field, then beat your own time.
An independent mini game inspired by The Tower. Play the browser version, or explore the rest of Tower Arcade for another kind of challenge.

features.title: Mines as weapons
features.text: Arm mines and use their blasts to clear the field.

features.title: Chain reactions
features.text: Connect detonations into a charged cluster.

features.title: A shielded boss
features.text: Hook your cluster into the boss to finish the encounter.

steps.title: Arm your mines
steps.text: Tap mines to prepare your attack.

steps.title: Chain their blasts
steps.text: Detonate mines to build a useful chain reaction.

steps.title: Break through
steps.text: Hook a charged cluster into the shielded boss, then try for a faster clear.

controls.action: Tap to arm and detonate · mouse or touch
Use the game’s menus to start a run and see its available options.

availability: Available to play in your browser on desktop and mobile. The Play button opens the game.
controlNote: The game’s own controls and menus provide any additional bindings.
